name: Digital Mahou Shoujo: [StellA;☆Luminous]
source:
Charlotte Skum is your typical trust-fund baby schoolgirl; she hangs out with her friends, keeps on top of the latest trends, and even has a small-time streaming career on the side.

But despite all this, Charlotte can't help but feel that something is missing. When a strange opportunity from the Digital World suddenly arises, will Charlotte choose to play the hero?

[From [url=https://bax888.itch.io/digimahou]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夏洛特·斯卡姆是个典型的富家千金女学生：平日里和朋友们逛街玩乐，紧跟最新潮流风向，私下里甚至还兼职做着小打小闹的主播。

尽管生活看似顺风顺水，夏洛特却总觉得心里缺了点什么。当来自“数码世界”的奇妙机缘骤然降临时，夏洛特会选择挺身而出扮演英雄吗？

[摘自[url=https://bax888.itch.io/digimahou]itch.io[/url]]
